body:
Follow-up evidence request, 19 October 2026. We are reusing this issue rather than opening a duplicate. These are public historical market-data observations; no account records or trading access are requested.

Could Binance clarify the effective timestamp/version semantics for the following **AERGOUSDT USD-M metrics** records, or publish corrected objects and old/new SHA-256 checksums? These cases do not coincide with the June 25 transition alleged in this issue, so we have not applied that proposed shift.

**Four off-grid observations (UTC):**

- [AERGOUSDT-metrics-2026-01-06.zip](https://data.binance.vision/data/futures/um/daily/metrics/AERGOUSDT/AERGOUSDT-metrics-2026-01-06.zip) — SHA-256 `cd95a32779f351c1ccaf142c45123da42796c349751d3906687dfed9349d00c5`; [publisher checksum](https://data.binance.vision/data/futures/um/daily/metrics/AERGOUSDT/AERGOUSDT-metrics-2026-01-06.zip.CHECKSUM); CSV line 32 (header included), timestamp `2026-01-06 02:35:02`.
- [AERGOUSDT-metrics-2026-01-20.zip](https://data.binance.vision/data/futures/um/daily/metrics/AERGOUSDT/AERGOUSDT-metrics-2026-01-20.zip) — SHA-256 `bcf874b41cd030efd052ecd09c6507c1c26036e2e696c33f1a78cf277696276d`; [publisher checksum](https://data.binance.vision/data/futures/um/daily/metrics/AERGOUSDT/AERGOUSDT-metrics-2026-01-20.zip.CHECKSUM); CSV line 246 (header included), timestamp `2026-01-20 20:25:02`.
- [AERGOUSDT-metrics-2026-01-22.zip](https://data.binance.vision/data/futures/um/daily/metrics/AERGOUSDT/AERGOUSDT-metrics-2026-01-22.zip) — SHA-256 `4feb74d2265f636ad720c5765096fcc7efe73262649f945b017ef73717966a87`; [publisher checksum](https://data.binance.vision/data/futures/um/daily/metrics/AERGOUSDT/AERGOUSDT-metrics-2026-01-22.zip.CHECKSUM); CSV line 187 (header included), timestamp `2026-01-22 15:30:02`.
- [AERGOUSDT-metrics-2026-03-18.zip](https://data.binance.vision/data/futures/um/daily/metrics/AERGOUSDT/AERGOUSDT-metrics-2026-03-18.zip) — SHA-256 `7850b49a9a8d0b7139fe9cb5a344d32d7507744f79e5c9ee058b5063838b5b00`; [publisher checksum](https://data.binance.vision/data/futures/um/daily/metrics/AERGOUSDT/AERGOUSDT-metrics-2026-03-18.zip.CHECKSUM); CSV line 234 (header included), timestamp `2026-03-18 19:25:02`.

**Conflicting midnight observations:**

- [AERGOUSDT-metrics-2026-06-11.zip](https://data.binance.vision/data/futures/um/daily/metrics/AERGOUSDT/AERGOUSDT-metrics-2026-06-11.zip) — SHA-256 `49bcebe61ef32043cb2a115b79ce1883644be7d48f6626e5552859f599661e76`; [publisher checksum](https://data.binance.vision/data/futures/um/daily/metrics/AERGOUSDT/AERGOUSDT-metrics-2026-06-11.zip.CHECKSUM). Its final midnight observation conflicts across all six metric fields with the following daily file.
- [AERGOUSDT-metrics-2026-06-27.zip](https://data.binance.vision/data/futures/um/daily/metrics/AERGOUSDT/AERGOUSDT-metrics-2026-06-27.zip) — SHA-256 `6a86e64e17b8b5c40ba3960c4a446e41db005d3d1653bd9066267b396ff657bf`; [publisher checksum](https://data.binance.vision/data/futures/um/daily/metrics/AERGOUSDT/AERGOUSDT-metrics-2026-06-27.zip.CHECKSUM). Its final midnight observation conflicts across all six metric fields with the following daily file.

The duplicate labels are `2026-06-12 00:00:00` (June 11/12 files) and `2026-06-28 00:00:00` (June 27/28 files). The comparison objects are [June 12](https://data.binance.vision/data/futures/um/daily/metrics/AERGOUSDT/AERGOUSDT-metrics-2026-06-12.zip) and [June 28](https://data.binance.vision/data/futures/um/daily/metrics/AERGOUSDT/AERGOUSDT-metrics-2026-06-28.zip). The six fields are `sum_open_interest`, `sum_open_interest_value`, `count_toptrader_long_short_ratio`, `sum_toptrader_long_short_ratio`, `count_long_short_ratio`, and `sum_taker_long_short_vol_ratio`.

The six retained anomaly files matched the publisher checksums checked on October 19. Could you provide (1) observation/aggregation timing for each field and effective change dates, (2) whether the two-second offsets are valid observation times or labeling errors, (3) the authoritative treatment of both versions at each duplicated midnight, and (4) correction/publication lineage? We have neither rounded timestamps nor selected one conflicting value. Related schema request: #509.

Please identify the responsible Binance data/Futures API team or route this request if needed. If a field or historical interval cannot be supported, please state that explicitly. We will preserve originals and keep validation blocked until the evidence supports a documented correction or historical interpretation. Thank you.
